text: What will it be? Fried toad legs are today's special! And I buy meat of all kinds.
Good evening! Here we drink, eat, gossip... and I pay well for fresh meat.
They say giant toads have been seen... and something bigger on the plains. A Queen, they say.
A blue-haired goddess was here the other day and left me the bill. But that's drunk talk.
They say a demon general is gathering armies. I hope he's bad at logistics.
